name: bendit
description: Enforced rules for coding agents: fail-closed guard hooks, a verification gate, engineering-practice skills, and /bendit:adopt to fit them to any project and prove they work.

integrationBranch.title: Integration branch
integrationBranch.description: Branch /bendit:ship and /bendit:review-diff diff against. Empty detects it from the git remote's default branch.

zshGuard.title: Guard zsh word-splitting
zshGuard.description: Refuse Bash commands that rely on unquoted word-splitting when your shell is zsh, where it does not happen.
